Nonnegative numeric counts may be zero; assertions may be fractional; command labels remain optional; producer attribution retains the existing report validator's truthy kind/id contract. No report replay, inferred positive count, planned/executed equality or historical rewrite is introduced. The source census found no other positive buildReceipt-only consumer to migrate: proof-authority.test.js uses it only for producer attribution, release-proof-identity.test.js uses it for intentionally invalid historical identity receipts, and its valid identity/index controls already record through the real owner. Those existing roots remain focused proof obligations. Original controls, physical candidate proof, independent verification and sealing remain pending.

seal.statement: The existing proof receipt reader requires the execution envelope emitted by validatedExecution before a stored receipt can satisfy exact lookup, release-content identity lookup, indexing or same-head recording reuse. Missing or malformed execution evidence stays unavailable without rewriting its historical object or ref. Valid identity-free corpus receipts and valid release receipts citing the exact corpus proof remain applicable, including a cited release with zero direct files, runs and assertions.
